## Workshops

With [CABANAnet](https://cabana.network/), a bioinformatics training network across Latin America, LatinGenomes will co-organize five hands-on workshops, one each year, in Costa Rica and other participating countries. Workshops cover computational pipelines for whole-genome and single-cell RNA sequencing analysis, so that every site can run the analyses, not only the largest ones.

Past LatinCells courses are listed at [latincells.org](https://www.latincells.org/en/cursos).

## Working with communities

Workshops also serve as meetings with local communities to share progress, as LatinCells has done before. Between them, in-person and remote consultations gather feedback from participants and other stakeholders, and that feedback shapes how results are reported in scientific articles and in the media.
